execution.humanEdits: 虚拟成员通过协同文档写入，触发条件为 Agent 完成对该文件的读取（60 秒未读取时按时间写入）

agentTasks: 属主 A 把 quote 的 amount 改为含税总额，并新增 net 表示税前金额，同步 invoiceNet
属主 B 增加 grossLabel，按 amount 与 tax 相加得到含税金额
scenarios.conflict: 属主 A 改变 amount 的含义而不改字段名，属主 B 按旧含义把 amount 与 tax 相加，结果重复计税，数值看似正常。
scenarios.mechanism: 灰区判断或意图差异卡片发现含义冲突，交给双方属主；属主采纳建议后，属主 B 的 Agent 改用 net，两人的意图都保留。
scenarios.acceptanceProbe: quote(100, 0.1, 'CNY') 的 amount 约为 101.7、net === 90、tax 约为 11.7；cart.invoiceNet(100) === 90；cart.grossLabel(100) === '101.70'
agentPrompts: In src/pricing.ts change quote so that amount is the tax-inclusive total (the discounted price plus tax) and add a net field holding the discounted price before tax. Keep tax unchanged. Update invoiceNet in src/cart.ts so it still returns the pre-tax amount. Preserve tests.

In src/cart.ts add exported grossLabel(price) using pricing.quote(price, 0.1, 'CNY'). quote returns the discounted amount and its tax; add them and return the sum as a string with two decimal places, such as '12.34'. Preserve existing tests.
